== Summary ==
Players Committee card image of [[Passage To The Alderaan System (Errata)]] (PC-E1 text), as published: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/103874657ec982c3002d76f0fe3347388d73f573/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Light/large/passagetothealderaansystem.gif Holotable image repository, commit 1038746] “Passage image fix”, 25 July 2024, a corrected image (“Passage image fix”). Uploaded unchanged (byte-for-byte copy of that commit's file; the PC stores it as PNG data under a .gif name, so it is uploaded here with a .png extension). Later replaced at the same address by the next version's image.

== Preservation ==
archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-0/08/V23-L-passagetothealderaansystem-PC-E1.png Internet Archive item].
